title: Incrust

inlines.v: INCRUST', verb transitive [Latin incrusto; in and crusto, to crust. To cover with a crust or with a hard coat; to form a crust on the surface of any substance; as iron incrusted with oxyd or rust; a vessel incrusted with salt.
